paraphrase: Six stipulated finite interpretations of the composition/uniting/causal vocabulary. Each of STMT-COMPOSITE-HAS-TWO-DISTINCT-COMPONENTS, STMT-DIVERSE-COMPONENTS-UNITED-ONLY-BY-A-CAUSE, STMT-UNITING-CAUSE-IS-EFFICIENT, STMT-UNITING-CAUSE-CAUSES-COMPOSITE-BEING and STMT-NOTHING-IS-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-OF-ITSELF has an interpretation in which it fails, the other four hold, and STMT-COMPOSITE-HAS-A-UNITING-CAUSE fails. In the first, STMT-COMPOSITE-HAS-COMPONENT-OTHER-THAN-ITSELF also holds. A sixth interpretation satisfies all five with a composite present. These are formal interpretations, not claims that any is metaphysically possible.
